note: Municipal District of Greenview No. 16 campground in the hamlet of Grande Cache, beside the ball diamonds, trails and the Grande Cache Golf & Country Club: large treed sites, a cook shack and an open tent area. Outside firewood is not allowed; it is sold on site. No off-highway vehicles. --Claude

flags: SITE COUNT: the M.D. page says '77 large treed sites (56 full-service, 21 partial-service, 1 open tenting area)', but Let's Camp sells 60 RV sites (43 with sewer, 17 without), four 15-amp tent-only sites (74-77) and four open tent areas - recorded the page's 77; a reviewer may prefer 60 RV sites.
SEASON: stored closes 10-31 (derived); the 2026 page says bookings close October 13, 2026 - recorded 10-13.

LONG STAY: a C$1,100 full-service monthly rate is offered 'contact for limited availability'; nightly sites are sold online with a 14-day maximum except monthly sites - an ordinary municipal campground.

PHONE: 780-827-2404 (stored) confirmed on the page ('Phone: 780-827-2404'). WEBSITE: the stored URL .../grande-cache-municipal-campground/ answered 200 after redirecting to .../grande-cache-campground/ - give the latter; letscamp.ca/camps/gccampground is the booking link.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): on Esri imagery the site loops lie in spruce forest between the golf course and an open field; no water near.
PIN (53.89520,-119.09750): on the east edge of the site loops; loop centre ~53.8952,-119.0987 (~80 m). No move.
